data.exact_reserve_text: Claims outstanding represent the estimated ultimate cost of settling all claims (including direct and indirect claims settlement costs) arising from events which have occurred up to the date of the statement of financial position, including IBNR, less any amounts paid in respect of those claims. Whilst the Directors consider that the estimate of claims outstanding is fairly calculated on the basis of the information currently available to them, there is inherent uncertainty in relation to the ultimate liability which will vary as a result of subsequent information and events. Adjustments to the amounts of the claims provisions established in prior years are reflected in the income statement for the period in which the adjustments are made.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2020 the Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (prior year comparative) was USD 4,274.9m. Analysis of the claims development triangle shows no material net prior year development (net movement ~0.0), i.e. reserves were broadly stable on a gross basis. The Syndicate highlights ongoing reserve uncertainty from increased frequency and magnitude of major events, medium loss uncertainty linked to climate change and increased insured values, social inflation in the US Casualty market and COVID-19 related pressures, but there is no quantified gross prior year strengthening or release disclosed for 2020.
raw_causal_phrases: The frequency of major events and the magnitude of the resulting claims continues to rise, with 2020's experience following on from those of 2017 and 2018, the most costly back-to-back years on record.

The impact of medium loss events is also uncertain, with commentators attributing an increase in the frequency and severity of such events to climate change and other factors such as population growth and increasing insured values.
Pressures on attritional ratios continue, largely driven by the soft market years of 2017 and 2018 and by social inflation in the US Casualty market.
Significant uncertainty still surrounds COVID-19 and the timeframes over which vaccination programmes will allow lockdowns to be eased.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (liabilities) prior year comparative (31 Dec 2019) = USD 4,274.9m (page 14). No explicit gross 'movement in prior year provision' note was found; prior year development was therefore computed from the gross claims development triangle (page 40) using the standard diagonal method (excluding the two most recent underwriting years). The triangle shows no material movement for older years (net PYD = 0.0). Some extracted tables omitted the '2010 & prior' aggregate in certain rows; the triangle reconstruction excluded the aggregate column per instructions. All amounts remain in the report's native currency (USD). Where explicit gross prior-year movement figures were absent, a triangle-derived result was used.
